'''Porel Vakra''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] personal assistant and bodyguard of [[Venlana Sipal]].

==History==
Porel Vakra had worked for the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] at least since [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] and was loyal to them, despite not holding a high position within the organization. He was appointed [[Underboss/Legends|underboss]] and personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Venlana Sipal]], whom he was tasked with [[Spy/Legends|spying]] on. During the conflict between the Zann Consortium and the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Socority]], Porel grew increasingly suspicious that Sipal was working for the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|pirate queen]].<ref name="Mask" /> After the [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] discovered the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] to be a mole and ordered several [[Thug/Legends|thugs]] to arrest her.<ref name="Mask" />

==Equipment==
Porel Vakra was equipped with two modified [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], an [[Armor/Legends|armored suit]], a [[Comlink/Legends|commlink]], and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="Mask" />
